verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS identity platform, but the evidence pack has no documented sandbox, test tenant, or non-production isolation feature in Entra ID. The community comments about creating tenants describe tenant setup friction, not a sandbox capability. At most they suggest a user-side workaround of spinning up a separate tenant, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
